request.style: English, lullaby, a mother's soft breathy voice with a gentle oud and frame drum played softly, water sounds, slow rocking, tender and anxious, 3/4, 60 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Three months I hid you in the house
I could not hide you any more
I made a basket out of reeds
And laid you by the river shore

[Chorus]
Sleep, little one, on the river
Sleep in the basket of reeds
The Lord will watch you on the water
Sleep, little one, sleep

[Verse]
Your sister watches from afar
To see what will become of you
The daughter of the king comes down
She sees you crying, and she knew

[Chorus]
Sleep, little one, on the river
Sleep in the basket of reeds
The Lord will watch you on the water
Sleep, little one, sleep
